visualCharacteristics: Single paragraph of inline blue links in the JBake 'Tag . ' style (no underline, underlined on hover), wrapping naturally. No layout changes across breakpoints.
contentPattern: Dynamic block with no authored rows. Collects every tag from blog posts in /query-index.json, dedupes by tag slug (most frequent casing wins), sorts alphabetically (French, accent/case-insensitive) and links each to /tags/<slug>.
usage: Use on the droff.com 'all tags' page (/listalltags) to link to every tag page; auto-updates from the query index.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever a full tag cloud/index is needed. Use post-list with a Tag row for the per-tag post listing.
